title: Specialty Pharmacy Program Tier Sheet: The Member's Guaranteed Share under Variable Copay
content:
**Rule.** Under the Specialty Pharmacy Program, the member's guaranteed share applies under a variable copay program when two things hold: the copay card has paid part, but not all, of the fill's cost share, and the variable copay floor is lower than that cost share. For a partial (split) fill the guaranteed share is the variable copay floor multiplied by the fill's days supply and divided by 30. For a full fill it is the variable copay floor. Otherwise no guaranteed share applies.

## Tier figures

| Tier | Coordination of manufacturer assistance | Variable copay floor |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Specialty Open Access | standard coordination | $0.00 (not used) |
| Northbridge Specialty Preferred | standard coordination | $0.00 (not used) |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive | standard coordination | $0.00 (not used) |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive with Copay Assist | variable copay | $25.00 |
| Northbridge Specialty Care Management | variable copay | $25.00 |
| Northbridge Specialty Total Care | maximizer | $0.00 (not used) |

## Conditions read from the records

- **The card has paid part but not all.** The copay card assistance applications naming the fill total more than zero and less than the fill's total cost share.
- **The floor is lower than the cost share.** The floor is below the fill's total cost share. A floor equal to the cost share is not lower.
- **Partial or full.** The fill's shipment shows whether it is a split fill and its days supply.

## Ladder

| Variable copay program | Card paid part but not all | Floor lower than the cost share | Fill | Guaranteed share |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | partial (split) | floor multiplied by the days supply, divided by 30 |
| Yes | Yes | Yes | full | the floor |
| any other combination | | | | none |

## Worked figures on a $25.00 floor (assumed fills)

| Fill cost share | Card payments on the fill | Fill | Guaranteed share |
|---|---|---|---|
| $90.00 | $70.00 | full | $25.00 |
| $45.00 | $30.00 | split, 15 days | $12.50 (15 thirtieths of $25.00) |
| $42.00 | $30.00 | split, 14 days | 14 thirtieths of $25.00, about $11.67, carried unrounded |
| $90.00 | $90.00 | full | none; the card paid all |
| $90.00 | $0.00 | full | none; the card paid nothing |
| $25.00 | $10.00 | full | none; the floor is not lower than the cost share |
| $20.00 | $10.00 | full | none; the floor is above the cost share |
